text:
Leila: Heads-up folks Clearing out some extras from my desk. Up for grabs: a portable sit-stand converter (Humanscale QuickStand mini, folds flat) and a pair of JBL Charge 4 Bluetooth speakers (both working). Also have 2x weekend passes to the SF Street Food Fest (Sat noon-4pm). Pick up from SOMA office today or tomorrow morning. Pics: https://imgur.com/quickstandjbl

Marco: Interested in the QuickStand. Does it fit on a 48in desk?

Leila: Yes it fits a 48in no problem. Weight is ~7.5kg, folds down to ~60cm x 40cm x 10cm. I'll leave an Allen key taped under it for assembly.

Dev: Id take the speakers if theyre still available. Battery life ok?

Leila: Speakers charge fine, battery holds ~10hrs at medium volume. Minor scuff on one corner. Includes USB-C cable.

OfficeBot: Building doors lock at 7:00pm. After-hours pickup requires a facilities escort. Freight elevator booking required for bulky items. See #eng-infra.

Nora: I can swing by tomorrow morning for the QuickStand. If someone else beats me to it, Im happy to take the speakers instead.

Marco: Can do today 5:45pm pickup. Will bring a friend to help carry. DMing phone now.

Dev: If Marco takes the stand and can't take the speakers, I'm still in for pickup today after 6pm. Otherwise tomorrow morning works too.

Leila: Plan: Ill put the QuickStand by Loading Dock B labeled "For Marco" and leave the speakers at the front desk in an envelope marked "Dev". Food fest passes Ill email to the first two people who reply in-thread and print a backup at the desk.

Nora: Thanks for organizing, Leila! If plans shift, please ping me.

Marco: Claimed the QuickStand. Picking up at 5:45. Thanks! :handshake:

Dev: Claimed the speakers. Grabbing them at 6pm. Thank you! :loud_sound:

Leila: All set. Sent the first food fest pass to @Marco via DM and emailed the second PDF to @Dev. I'll leave a printed copy at the desk just in case. If anything changes I'll update here. Enjoy! :sparkles:

Nora: If one of the passes falls through, Id love to take it. Thanks for sharing these, Leila. :raised_hands:

(Reaction: Marco reacted with :package: to Leila's first message)
